notes: Roche publishes employees by region (Annual Report 2025 highlights map; headcount at Dec 31, 2025, total 112,774). The 2025 figures are headcounts under the broader ESRS scope (including apprentices, interns and individuals on unpaid leave), so they are not comparable with the 2024 FTE figures (103,249); Roche says the underlying workforce was broadly unchanged. The regions are Roche's own groupings with no country list, except Australia/New Zealand. The Annual Report 2025 sustainability table also gives headcount for two selected countries (Germany 18,768; Switzerland 17,752; others 76,254); these were not added as rows because they overlap the Europe region and are a new breakdown. No U.S. state breakdown, or country breakdown of sites or taxes, was found in the Annual Report 2025. Roche does not file with the SEC. The Annual Report PDFs are served from Roche's asset CDN (assets.roche.com). Sites are those the Annual Report 2024 names (that PDF is still online); the 2025 report does not repeat most of them, and Roche does not list its major facilities in either report. State codes for the U.S. sites come from the place names (the report says only "(US)").
